question: What is the area of a rhombus, whose sides are 25 cm and one of the diagonals is 14 cm?
solution:
**Given**

Sides of a rhombus = 25 cm

Diagonal of rhombus = 14 cm

**Formula used**

Area of triangle = √s(s -a) (s -b) (s - c)

s is the semi - the perimeter of the triangle. a, b and c are the sides of the triangle

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83798e20d301eefae2b347b190ace47d2e7a2018272ec2183fd07b32ec656bf0.png] 

Let ABCD is a rhombus. Side AB = BC = CD = DA = 25 cm and AC = 14 cm

a = 25 cm, b = 25 cm, c = 14 m

s = (25 + 25 + 14)
